verdict.rationale: Weave documents built-in/custom 'signals' and 'guardrail' scorers that continuously classify live agent/production traffic and trigger Slack/webhook alerts, and states users can test models 'against production traces' — going beyond pure offline dataset evaluation. However, the core 'Evaluation' object workflow is framed around Datasets/test cases, and there is no explicit doc describing scheduling the same Scorer objects to run continuously as a production monitoring pipeline (vs. one-off signal tagging or guardrail checks per call). missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduling/continuous evaluation jobs over live production streams, independent confirmation of always-on evaluator execution, and clarity on how Evaluation-object scorers map onto the signals/guardrails mechanism.
